selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Before proposing or reviewing Units of Work, load the binding unit template and validate that every unit is a live vertical story slice; contracts, migrations, backend, UI, and evidence must travel inside the slice that exercises them rather than becoming standalone layer units.

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: When multiple vertical slices change one service database, assign the ordered migration chain and files to one explicit unit; later slices consume the prepared schema and must not co-own or rewrite those migration files.
